datasets.description: Input dataset(s) with sub-brick selector list support
datasets.title: Input datasets

dmean.description: Remove the mean from each input brick (across space)
dmean.title: Demean across space flag

vmean.description: Remove the mean from each input voxel (across bricks)
vmean.title: Demean across bricks flag

vnorm.description: L2 normalize each input voxel time series
vnorm.title: Voxel normalization flag

normalize.description: L2 normalize each input brick (after mean subtraction)
normalize.title: Brick normalization flag

nscale.description: Scale the covariance matrix by the number of samples
nscale.title: Scale covariance matrix flag

pcsave.description: 'sss' is the number of components to save in the output
pcsave.title: Save components

reduce.description: Compute a dimensionally reduced dataset with top 'r' eigenvalues and write to disk in dataset 'pp'
reduce.title: Dimensionally reduced output

dummy_lines.description: Add 'ddd' dummy lines to the top of each *.1D file
dummy_lines.title: Number of dummy lines

verbose.description: Print progress reports during the computations
verbose.title: Verbose flag

eigonly.description: Only compute eigenvalues, write them to 'pname'_eig.1D, then stop
eigonly.title: Eigenvalues only flag

mask.description: Use the 0 sub-brick of dataset 'mset' as a mask indicating which voxels to analyze
mask.title: Mask file
